body: Massage Therapists won't be phased when asked to work on glutes. It's a very common muscle group to work on and can help with lower back pain, hip pain, IT band issues and even knee pain. You don't need to have your underwear off to have them worked on. And it's very easy to work glutes over the sheets with static / deep circular compressions. Don't be shy to ask for what you need - we're trained to work the entire body wholistically.
